name: Ostannya plivka
source:
You are at a doctor's appointment, and exactly five sessions will help you understand what happened to the main character [b]that[/b] day.

[Translated from [url=https://belowemptyskies.itch.io/thelastrecord]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在接受医生的问诊，而整整五次诊疗过程，将帮助你弄清[b]那一天[/b]主角身上究竟发生了什么。

[译自[url=https://belowemptyskies.itch.io/thelastrecord]itch.io[/url]]
